info.description: Deterministic logical simulations and guarded real Docker HTTP traffic. Server edits affect future snapshots. Upload CSV inputs, queue durable work, then read committed progress and verified result artifacts. Sequential execution without scaling supports the supplied evaluator; concurrent and scaled results use independent replay. The normal installation accepts up to 10,000 requests and 10 MiB CSV uploads.
